term: grounding, complete grounds, reason projection and enabling rules
resolution: Existential candidate grounding in A, fact-set ground candidates in C, fact-to-fact admitted reasons, efficient causation in Ontic and potential ground/enabler rule links in D remain different interpretations. reasonView is an explicit structural adapter into the existing forced lemma, not an assertion that R is genuine explanatory sufficiency. Only the entire full member set carries JointNecessitation; enablers outside it invalidate an advertised completeness/sufficiency reading. WF is independently stipulated, not hidden in a word. A necessary fact is not a necessary being, and a selected contingent terminus need not be the original target.
